title: The Laws of Attraction
heading: The Laws of Attraction
coreClaim: Attraction strengthens through repeated contact, reciprocity, self-disclosure, and support that feels responsive and identity-confirming.
distinctMechanism: Exposure begins the process, but attraction deepens only when the relationship becomes reciprocal, appropriately disclosive, and supportive.
requiredAnchors: People often become friends with those they cross paths with regularly.
The move from acquaintanceship to friendship is marked by reciprocal self-disclosure.
Supportiveness and responsive understanding help attraction last.
specificApplications: Diagnose why repeated contact has not turned into attraction.
Recognize when one-sided support is weakening the bond.
commonMisreadings: More intimate disclosure is always better.
Attraction means romance rather than broader human liking and closeness.
hardEdgeRequirement: Hard depth must preserve that attraction can fail when disclosure is too intimate too early or when the relationship is not reciprocal enough to hold the disclosures safely.
thresholdQuestion: When does openness deepen attraction, and when does it reveal imbalance instead?
